content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) defines glucose abnormalities as follows: Hyperglycemia is characterized by a random blood glucose level exceeding 140 mg/dL (7.8 mmol/L). Hypoglycemia is categorized into three levels: Level 1 hypoglycemia is defined by a specific range of low glucose concentrations. Level 2 hypoglycemia is also determined by glucose concentrations but represents a more severe drop in blood sugar levels. Level 3 hypoglycemia is a critical condition that requires external assistance due to its severity.
